method: Images inspected with view_image; no claim of human audio listening.
observations: Top/center/bottom text blocks stay within the composition and show distinct sizes/styles.
Multiline text is horizontally centered per line; accents, quote, percent and backslash are rendered literally.
Cover fills the portrait frame; SAR contain preserves the wider display ratio with neutral bands.
Rotation metadata produces a portrait-oriented image in the inspected rotated fixture.
limitations: white_plain has no outline and can lose contrast over bright content; choose an outlined style for those scenes.
Visual review covers synthetic representative frames, not every possible font glyph or source.
No subjective human auditory inspection was performed; signal checks are documented in the matrix report.
